name: Isometric mono
blurb: True isometric, green ramp, platform slab
mechanism: A true-isometric diorama on one rounded, bevelled off-white slab, every face filled from a single five-step green ramp by the direction it faces (top lightest, right darkest), every edge outlined in 0.9 deep green, with fine 0.35-0.6 repeated detail lines and soft green floor shadows and glows.

palette.name: Off-white
palette.role: slab top, top faces of light objects, label plates

palette.name: Pale mint
palette.role: top-face accents, slab chamfer, highlights, lit LEDs

palette.name: Mint
palette.role: left (+y) faces of light objects, slab band, code lines

palette.name: Mid green
palette.role: right (+x) faces, left faces of mid objects, glows, detail lines

palette.name: Deep green
palette.role: right faces of mid objects, keys, shadows, fine ribs

palette.name: Very deep
palette.role: screens, keypads, rack units, mug interiors

line: Outline #0f3d30 0.9 on object edges and silhouettes; 0.5-0.55 for insets and panels; 0.35-0.45 for tiny parts; detail lines 0.4-1.2 in ramp greens; round joins and caps.
rules: True isometric: plan x and y at 30 degrees, z straight up, no vanishing points.
Fill each face by orientation: top lightest, left mid, right darkest.
Outline every edge in deep green at 0.9; details at 0.35-0.6.
Everything stands on one rounded, bevelled off-white slab.
Every object casts a soft shadow toward the lower right.
Seven to nine objects, tall ones at the back.
